items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I started using it with Sharky... I used it in the hotel with Sharky... I had met Sharky before I went away and that's why I knew Sharky in New York.

ctx.x: Because most of the work I did was rhythm work, and a lot of times I didn't use the amplifier much, or very little, you know what I mean? And so I didn't want to buy one of them electric guitars, because I... They're no good then. I never was a solo host, I thought I'd have been solo playing or something like that, it'd been different, but... When did you start using amplifier? I started using it with Sharky, but I wasn't using it too much with Sharky, because I played strictly Dixieland most of the time, you know.
You didn't want to use the amplifier?
